theorem gaussian_query_complexity_lower_bound_real {d : ℕ} {κ ε : ℝ}
    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hsmall : ε ≤ 1/16) :
    (1/256 : ℝ) * min (d : ℝ) (Real.sqrt κ * Real.log (1 + (d : ℝ)/(Real.sqrt κ * ε))) ≤
      (gaussianQueryComplexity.{0,0} d κ ε).toReal := by
  have hfinite := (gaussian_query_complexity_le_dimension d κ hε.le).trans_lt
    (ENNReal.natCast_lt_top d)
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite.ne (gaussian_query_complexity_lower_bound hd hκ hε hsmall)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal'] at h
  exact (le_max_left _ _).trans h

theorem gaussian_query_lower_bound_with_disclosed_spectrum
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ' : δ < 1) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d ≥ d₀, ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ → κ ≤ (d : ℝ)^(1-δ) →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/10 →
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ/256 * Real.sqrt κ * Real.log (d : ℝ)) ≤ disclosedQueryComplexity.{u,v} d κ ε ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (δ/256 * Real.sqrt κ * Real.log (d : ℝ)) ≤ gaussianQueryComplexity.{u,v} d κ ε := by
  refine query_complexities_from_representation ?_ hδ hδ'
  intro d q κ _ hn Seed State _ _ ρ _ alg
  exact actual_output_representation κ hn.le ρ alg
